Climate management reaches new levels with the Climate Comfort Package, offering 5-Zone Automatic Climate Control, front ventilated seats, and front massaging seats that adapt to your preferences. The M Sport Professional Package elevates performance and aesthetics with M Sport Brakes featuring black calipers, M Sport Package Pro enhancements, and Extended Shadowline Trim that sharpens the exterior presence. The 4.4L V8 delivers responsive power, returning 16 city and 21 highway MPG.

With 14,599 miles, this X7 M60i offers the opportunity to own a nearly new luxury SUV equipped with an impressive array of premium features. Schedule your appointment to experience this remarkable vehicle today.

Wireless smartphone integration and trip computer display provide essential driving information at a glance.

description:
Meet this 2023 Ford F-250SD XL, a powerful diesel work truck that combines capability with practical upgrades designed for both on and off-road performance. With a Power Stroke 6.7L V8 turbodiesel engine paired to a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck delivers the dependable power and control you need for serious work and weekend adventures.

- 37 TOYO Open Country tires
- 4 MAXTRAC lift kit with KMC custom wheels
- VULCAN 2.0 shocks for enhanced suspension
- STX Appearance Package with upgraded interior door panels
- FX4 Off-Road Package including Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned shocks
- 360-Degree Camera System with picture-in-picture capability
- Pre-Collision Assist and Automatic Emergency Braking
- Rear Parking Sensors with reverse brake assist
- BLIS with Cross-Traffic Alert
- LED box lighting and LED fog lamps
- Electronic-locking differential with 3.31 axle ratio
- Dual 68 AH AGM batteries
- SYNC 4 infotainment system
- BoxLink bed management system
- Power-sliding rear window with defrost

The exterior showcases body-color front and rear bumpers, a painted grille, and distinctive FX4 off-road badging. The 18 ebony black painted aluminum wheels paired with fresh 37 all-terrain tires give this truck an aggressive stance ready for any terrain. LED lighting throughout, including automatic high beams and fog lamps, ensures visibility in all conditions.

Inside, the cloth 40/20/40 split bench seat with center armrest provides comfortable seating for three across, while the color-coordinated full carpet keeps the cabin looking sharp. SYNC 4 delivers smartphone integration and voice control, and steering wheel audio controls keep you focused on the road. The 360-degree camera system with multiple viewing angles makes maneuvering easier, whether backing up to a trailer or parking in tight spaces.

The FX4 Off-Road Package demonstrates this truck's versatility with off-road specific tuned shock absorbers front and rear, transfer case and fuel tank skid plates, and Hill Descent Control for confident downhill navigation. Combined with the electronic-locking 3.31 axle ratio and the lift kit with premium VULCAN 2.0 shocks, this F-250 is equipped to handle challenging terrain while maintaining on-road stability.

This truck shows 43,762 miles and represents a well-maintained example of the F-250SD XL platform. The Power Stroke diesel engine features an engine block heater for cold-weather starts, dual advanced battery systems, and a 34-gallon fuel tank to keep you going longer between fill-ups. The comprehensive safety suite includes dual front impact and side impact airbags, ABS brakes with brake assist, electronic stability control, and low tire pressure warning.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this F-250SD XL firsthand. Our team is ready to walk you through its features and answer any questions about this capable diesel truck.

The infotainment system provides seamless smartphone integration through wireless projection, and the Bose audio system ensures quality sound whether streaming music or enjoying satellite radio.

Off-road capabilities are enhanced through the X31 package, which includes an off-road suspension setup, Hill Descent Control, and an auto-locking rear differential. Forward Collision Alert, Front Pedestrian Braking, and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning add layers of driver awareness and confidence on every journey.

This Sierra SLT combines practical truck functionality with the everyday convenience and technology you expect from a modern full-size pickup. Whether tackling projects, towing from the Trailering Package, or cruising town, this truck is equipped to handle your needs with style and capability.

The three-row seating arrangement accommodates up to seven passengers, with the third row featuring reclining capability and a split-folding design for flexible cargo management. Individually controlled climate zones ensure every occupant maintains their preferred temperature, while the integrated massaging function in the front seats addresses the fatigue that comes with extended driving.

Technology integration spans the full spectrum of modern convenience and safety. The head-up display projects critical driving information onto the windshield, minimizing distraction. Navigation guidance works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay, keeping you connected while your attention stays focused on the road. The advanced suspension system, including independent four-wheel suspension with auto-leveling capability, maintains composed handling regardless of road conditions or load distribution.

Safety systems throughout this X7 provide comprehensive occupant protection with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags working in concert with electronic stability control and traction management. The all-wheel-drive platform enhances stability during adverse weather, while multiple airbag zones and an emergency communication system through BMW Assist eCall demonstrate a layered approach to occupant security.

With 82,998 miles on the odometer, this M50i represents a well-maintained example of BMW's flagship three-row luxury SUV. The vehicle's condition reflects careful ownership and regular service, providing confidence in its mechanical integrity and long-term reliability potential for the next owner.

This 2020 Ford Transit-350 Base is a purpose-built commercial vehicle ready to support your business operations with proven reliability and capability.

- EcoBoost 3.5L V6 Twin Turbocharged engine with Auto Start-Stop Technology
- Dual Alternators (250 Amps Each) and Dual AGM Batteries (70 Amp-hr Each)
- Reverse Sensing System with Back Up Alarm (102 dB(A) warning capability)
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear for enhanced visibility
- Perimeter Alarm and Panic Alarm for security
- Front & Rear Vinyl Floor Covering with Wheel Well Liners

- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Heavy-Duty Front Axle with 4-Wheel Disc Brakes and ABS
- Auto High-beam Headlights and Fully Automatic Headlights
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel with Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Power Door Mirrors with Short-Arm Manual-Folding Power Adjust
- AM/FM Stereo with 4 Speakers
- Remote Keyless Entry and Illuminated Entry
- Comprehensive airbag system including Dual Front Impact and Dual Front Side Impact Airbags

Built to deliver performance in challenging work environments, this Transit-350 features an enhanced electrical system designed for demanding applications. The dual alternators and dual batteries provide the power stability needed for auxiliary equipment and continuous operation, while the modified wiring provisions accommodate custom configurations for your specific needs.

The cab is equipped for driver comfort during long workdays, with vinyl bucket seats, an armrest, and intuitive controls positioned for easy access. The telescoping steering wheel adjusts to your preferred driving position, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Safety and visibility are prioritized with comprehensive features including electronic stability control, traction control, a heavy-duty front axle, and disc brakes on all four wheels. The reverse sensing system and backup alarm provide additional protection when maneuvering in tight spaces, while the rear camera gives you a clear view behind the vehicle.

Practical design helps you maximize every workday. Vinyl flooring throughout resists damage and cleans easily, wheel well liners protect against debris, and the perimeter alarm system protects your investment when parked. The 16-inch steel wheels with black hubcaps are designed to handle commercial-grade wear.

This Transit-350 comes ready to work and ready to earn. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and see how this vehicle can support your business goals.

Inside, the A5 Sportback combines comfort with purposeful design. Heated front bucket seats and the heated steering wheel enhance cold-weather driving, while the driver seat memory function personalizes your seating position. The automatic temperature control with front dual-zone and rear air conditioning ensures passenger comfort throughout the cabin. Genuine wood accents on the dashboard, door panels, and console insert establish an atmosphere of quality craftsmanship.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes work in concert to support vehicle stability. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and Audi connect CARE emergency communication system provide additional protection and peace of mind.

The Convenience Package integrates practical technologies to streamline your daily drive. Adaptive Cruise Control maintains your set speed and distance from traffic ahead, while Parking System Plus with front and rear acoustic sensors guides you into tight spaces. Audi Side Assist with Pre Sense Rear alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes, and the exterior parking camera rear provides visual confirmation when reversing.

This 2023 A5 Sportback Premium quattro presents an opportunity to own a vehicle that balances luxury appointments, intelligent technology, and dependable all-wheel-drive capability. We invite you to schedule a time to drive this Audi and experience its refined character firsthand.

The 2024 Dodge Durango GT Plus in Black delivers a commanding presence on the road with robust styling that captures attention wherever you go. This three-row SUV combines practical space with purposeful engineering, offering room for up to seven passengers and the capability to handle your family's most demanding days. The integrated roof rail crossbars provide practical cargo solutions for active lifestyles.

Beyond the advanced driver assistance systems already mentioned, the blind-spot monitoring includes trailer detection a valuable feature when towing. The collision warning system and lane-keeping assist provide watchful protection, while the rear load-leveling suspension automatically adjusts to handle cargo weight. The exterior mirrors feature memory settings, heating elements, and supplemental signals for comprehensive visibility.

Fuel economy rates at 18 city and 25 highway MPG, balancing the V6's responsive performance with reasonable consumption for a vehicle of this size and capability. The heavy-duty engine cooling system and 180-amp alternator ensure reliable operation under demanding conditions. Whether managing school runs, weekend adventures, or weekend getaways, this Durango accommodates your lifestyle without compromise.

The Durango GT Plus stands ready to serve as your family's command center on the road. With its thoughtful blend of passenger space, advanced safety features, connected technology, and all-wheel-drive capability, this SUV addresses the needs of drivers who expect more from their vehicles. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this model firsthand and discover how it aligns with your driving priorities.

Built for both work and leisure, this truck features a spray-in bedliner, four adjustable cargo tie-down hooks, and integrated bed lighting for secure cargo management. The 33-gallon fuel tank and 4-corner air suspension combine to deliver a dependable platform whether you're hauling equipment or enjoying weekend adventures. With 70,630 miles on the odometer, this Laramie remains well-maintained and ready for years of service.

This 2019 Chevrolet Suburban Premier combines spacious family capability with premium comfort and advanced technology features that make every journey more enjoyable.

- 2nd Row Captain's Chairs

- Rear Seat Entertainment System with DVD
- Power Sunroof with Express-Open/Close

The Suburban Premier delivers the space and versatility your family needs. This three-row layout accommodates passengers comfortably, with second-row captain's chairs providing individual comfort and easy access to the rear seating. The 60/40 power-folding third row expands cargo space when needed, giving you flexibility for both people and equipment.

Premium materials and thoughtful design define the interior. Perforated leather-appointed seating, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear outboard seats ensure comfort throughout the cabin regardless of weather. The heated steering wheel and memory settings for seat and pedal positions add personalized convenience to daily driving.

Technology makes ownership more connected and safer. The 8-inch color touch-screen navigation system displays traffic information in real time, while the Bose audio system delivers quality sound for music, podcasts, or SiriusXM radio throughout the drive. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keep your smartphone accessible, and the rear seat DVD entertainment system keeps passengers engaged on longer trips. Safety features include forward collision alert, lane keep assist, rear cross traffic alert, and front and rear parking sensors with camera display.

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine provides the power and capability expected from this full-size SUV, paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive for efficient highway driving. The adaptive suspension system adjusts to road conditions, and magnetic ride control contributes to smooth handling. You'll appreciate features like power steering, traction control, and electronic stability control that enhance confidence behind the wheel.

The exterior reflects premium styling with 22-inch premium painted wheels, power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting, and a power liftgate for convenient cargo access. The sunroof adds brightness and openness to the cabin. A beige exterior with iridescent pearl tricoat finish presents a refined appearance.

When you're ready to experience this capable, comfortable Suburban Premier for yourself, we welcome you to visit our showroom for a complete inspection and test drive.
